display.purpose: The wordmark, once per surface. Bodoni's thick-to-hairline contrast mirrors the ornament: a solid shape closed by a gold hairline.

label.purpose: Field labels and metadata. Uppercase, tracked, tabular figures.

shadows.name: plate
shadows.purpose: The standard raised surface. Offset and blur are both real; the inset is the lit top edge of the plate.

motion.name: ease-leaf
motion.purpose: Exponential ease-out from an already-visible default. The only easing in the system.

motion.name: leaf-catch
motion.purpose: The authored moment: a specular pass travelling once along a gold hairline as the surface settles. One orchestrated moment, not scattered hovers. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one leaf-filled action per surface. Solid prada with ink drawn on top.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--paes-prada, #dd9d63); color: var(--paes-ink, #1a1a1a); border: 1px solid var(--paes-prada-lit, #edbe92); border-radius: 18px 18px 6px 6px; height: 52px; padding: 0 28px; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background .22s ease, transform .22s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--paes-prada-lit, #edbe92); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.99); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--paes-prada-lit, #edbe92); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action. The hairline strengthens on hover rather than a fill appearing.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--paes-melati-2, #d8cbbc); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #dd9d63 35%, transparent); border-radius: 12px 12px 4px 4px; height: 52px; padding: 0 28px; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .22s ease, color .22s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #dd9d63 70%, transparent); color: var(--paes-melati, #f5ede1); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Category filter. Selected takes solid leaf with ink text.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: var(--paes-ground, #241416); color: var(--paes-melati-2, #d8cbbc); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #dd9d63 30%, transparent); border-radius: 999px; padding: 10px 15px; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; transition: border-color .2s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, #dd9d63 60%, transparent); } .ds-chip--selected { background: var(--paes-prada, #dd9d63); color: var(--paes-ink, #1a1a1a); border-color: var(--paes-prada-lit, #edbe92); }

components.name: Look Card
components.description: The repeated atom. Portrait edge to edge, facts below on a band closed by a prada rule, each fact on its own line.
components.html:
Akad Pagi
BRIDAL · 3 HR 30
Rp 8.500.000
components.css: .ds-card { display: block; background: var(--paes-ground-2, #3a181c); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #dd9d63 30%, transparent); border-radius: 26px 26px 8px 8px; overflow: hidden; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, #dd9d63 10%, transparent) inset, 0 12px 28px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.75); } .ds-card__media { height: 152px; background: var(--paes-ground, #241416); } .ds-card__band { border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #dd9d63 30%, transparent); padding: 10px 12px 12px; } .ds-card__title { font-family: 'Bodoni Moda', Georgia, serif; font-size: 17px; line-height: 1.05; color: var(--paes-melati, #f5ede1); } .ds-card__meta { margin-top: 6px; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--paes-melati-3, #a89685); } .ds-card__price { margin-top: 8px; font-family: 'Bodoni Moda', Georgia, serif; font-size: 15px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--paes-prada, #dd9d63); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Ground fill with a prada hairline; the border strengthens on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 46px; background: var(--paes-ground, #241416); color: var(--paes-melati, #f5ede1); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #dd9d63 30%, transparent); border-radius: 18px 18px 6px 6px; padding: 0 14px; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; outline: none; caret-color: var(--paes-prada, #dd9d63); transition: border-color .2s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--paes-melati-3, #a89685); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--paes-prada, #dd9d63); }

components.name: Tab Bar Item
components.description: The active tab is marked by a penunggul beneath the label. The row reserves the marker's height so switching tabs moves the leaf rather than shifting the bar.
components.html: HomeLooks
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; grid-auto-flow: column; background: var(--paes-ink, #1a1a1a); border-top: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #dd9d63 35%, transparent); padding: 10px 6px; } .ds-tab { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; text-decoration: none; font-family: Archivo, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px; color: var(--paes-melati-3, #a89685); } .ds-tab--active { color: var(--paes-prada, #dd9d63); } .ds-tab__mark--off { opacity: 0; }

narrative.overview:
Paes ageng is the ornament a Javanese bride wears across her brow on the morning of the akad: matte black shapes set out to prescribed proportion on her own skin, each one closed with a hairline of gold prada leaf. This interface is built from that ornament rather than decorated with it. The five leaves are the brand mark, the tab-bar position marker, the section rule, and the ground of every image slot still waiting on a photograph.

The consequence is a surface drenched in warm ink, where the brightest thing on any screen is a face. That is not an aesthetic preference: the product is colour on skin, so the ground exists to make photographed skin luminous and to be legible to a woman scrolling in bed at eleven at night, months out from her wedding. Gold never glows and never gradients — it is leaf, and leaf has an edge.

The world this replaced was a cream ground with glassmorphism and Plus Jakarta Sans. That is the confirmed anti-reference: it is the look every generated app arrives at, and escaping it was the brief.
keyCharacteristics: Warm near-black ground, never neutral grey, never cream
Gold as hairline edge; solid fill reserved for exactly one action per surface
Display type at architectural scale against small exact labels, with nothing in between
Every ornament drawn as authored SVG, never a glyph or an approximating border-radius
Bilingual by construction: `both` is the default language mode, so every label is roughly double width

rules.name: The Leaf Rule
rules.body: Prada is an edge. It may outline, rule, or letter — it may not glow, gradient, or blur. The one exception is the single primary action on a surface, where the leaf is laid solid with ink drawn on top (7.4:1).

rules.name: The One Action Rule
rules.body: Exactly one leaf-filled control per surface. A second one means the first was not the primary action.

rules.name: The Warm Ground Rule
rules.body: Every neutral carries red. If a grey samples cooler than its neighbours, it is wrong — blue-black slate is the drift this system exists to avoid.

rules.name: The Nothing-In-Between Rule
rules.body: Type is either display-scale or small and exact. A 17px semi-bold heading is the previous world; if a size feels like a compromise, it is one.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums is set on body. This product is made of prices, dates and durations, and proportional figures make a price column wobble.

rules.name: The Arc
rules.body: Every radius is the penunggul resolved into a corner: pronounced at the top, nearly square where it rests. A plate sits on a line; it does not float, and it is never uniformly rounded.

dos: Do write element selectors inside @layer base and material classes inside @layer components. Tailwind emits utilities in cascade layers, and an unlayered rule silently outranks every one of them.
Do use text-onprada for any text sitting on a gold fill. `ink` now names the light foreground of a dark world and is exactly wrong there.
Do give every new label both languages. `both` is the default mode and renders short labels as EN · ID, so budget roughly double width.
Do draw new icons into components/ui/Icons.tsx on the 24px / 1.75 grid.

Do let block-level links inherit their colour; only prose links inside

or
donts: Don't put a label above a heading. The heading carries its own weight.
Don't render gold as a glow, a gradient, or a soft shadow.
Don't reach for a Unicode glyph as an icon. The system has drawn replacements for all of them.
Don't introduce a cream, parchment or ivory ground, or Plus Jakarta Sans. That is the world this system replaced.
Don't stack a category, duration and price on one row at grid width — they truncate. Each gets its own line.
